name: type1-not-available-to-geojson
source: values chosen for this vector (as type1-all-not-available)
reference: Not-available codes are carried as values: lon 181, lat 91, course 360, speed 1023 x 1852/36000 = 52.62766666666667 (pack.md, Not-available codes on decode). geojson writes coordinates [lon, lat], properties in field-line order (callsign, course, speed_ms), then id (ruling 4 of 0.1.1); uid is derived as text_of(ais.mmsi) (model/ais.def), so it is checked with @complete.; longitude 181, latitude 91, speed 1023 and course 3600 are not available (AIVDM.adoc, common navigation block), so none reaches GeoJSON
